title: Chapter 717 - 717 Zhu Yan'S Death; Curse!
content:
Chapter 717 - 717 Zhu Yan'S Death; Curse!

Chapter 717 - 717 Zhu Yan's Death; Curse!

717 Zhu Yan’s Death; Curse!

Lin Fan looked at Kathleen’s back as she left, and a strange look appeared on his face.

Back then, when he rejected Zhu Yan, the other party directly generated five stars of hatred toward him.

Now, he had also rejected Kathleen, but she had developed a five-star favorability of him?

Lin Fan touched his nose and thought, “Indeed, handsome men are more popular with women.”

Then, he walked forward as well.

After getting Kathleen’s help, Lin Fan’s journey on the life path was much easier.

When he reached 8,100 meters, he had no choice but to stop because of the pressure.

Following that, he walked on the paths of metal, wood, water, fire, earth, yin, yang, and so on. He had a deeper understanding of all the laws.

“Phew!”

After Lin Fan left the River of Time, he let out a breath of air, causing the entire Earth to be filled with a refreshing breeze. It was extremely comfortable.

His cultivation had increased greatly again.

Then, he turned his attention back to Curse and Zhu Yan.

[Do you want to spend one million spirit stones to curse Zhu Yan?]

“Yes!”

In the inner space, one million spirit stones were directly turned into ashes.

…

On the other hand…

In the endless starry sky.

Zhu Yan, the Demon Sect’s sect master, the Water God Palace’s palace master, the 10,000 Demon Sect’s sect master, and the Thunder Sect’s sect master were fighting fiercely together.

The space shattered, and the wind howled.

The terrifying aftershock of the battle turned the area within hundreds of thousands of miles into nothingness.

It had to be said that Zhu Yan and the Demon Sect’s master’s strength was indeed extraordinary.

It was two against three, but they were not at a disadvantage.

In fact, they even suppressed the other party.

Just as Zhu Yan was about to use his ultimate move to heavily injure the palace master of Water God Palace…

At this moment, Zhu Yan’s body suddenly emitted a terrifying black aura.

This black gas was like a devil that tightly wrapped around him, causing his face to turn black and white.

He could not help but let out a painful howl.

In a battle between experts, even the slightest mistake could lead to great danger.

The palace master of Water God Palace naturally would not miss this opportunity.

He mobilized his energy and shot out several water columns that were tens of thousands of meters thick from the dimensional space. Like laser beams, they bombarded Zhu Yan from all directions.

Zhu Yan spat out a mouthful of blood. The armor on his body cracked and shattered. He was like a deflated ball, completely dispirited.

When the Demon Sect’s sect master saw this, his body froze slightly.

The sect masters of 10,000 Demons Sect and the Thunder Sect seized the opportunity and attacked him together.

The sect master of the Demon Sect had no choice but to dodge in a panic. His figure flashed as he directly arrived beside Zhu Yan. He shouted in a low voice, “Let’s go!”

The two of them leaped up and disappeared into the endless void.

Although they had won, the palace master of Water God Palace and the sect masters of the 10,000 Demons Sect and the Thunder Sect did not look too happy.

The three of them looked at each other and started discussing.

“Did you see that just now?”

“Zhu Yan seems to have been cursed.”

“Possessing the power to curse Zhu Yan… Who exactly is it?”

The three of them fell into a short silence.

Although they did not want to admit it, Zhu Yan was indeed stronger than them.

If that person could curse Zhu Yan, then they could also curse them.

An existence that hid in the dark and possessed powerful curse power was very terrifying.

…

At this moment, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Your enemy, Zhu Yan, was greatly affected by your curse and was attacked by an expert. He’s seriously injured.]

When Lin Fan heard that, his lips curled up. “He’s finally seriously injured. I have to continue working hard!”

The next day, he cursed Zhu Yan as scheduled.

On the third day, he continued to curse him.

…

In the blink of an eye, a year had passed.

In the endless starry sky, in Fire God Palace.

Zhu Yan’s body was suddenly filled with endless black gas, and his entire body kept twisting.

He was like a ferocious beast, roaring crazily.

“Ah!

“Who is it? Who’s the one cursing?!

“Sect master of the Demon Sect!”

Zhu Yan seemed to have figured everything out.

That was right!

It must be him!

He cursed him, forcing him to form an alliance with him and attack the Water God Palace, the 10,000 Demons Sect, and the Thunder Sect.

No wonder the sect master of the Demon Sect agreed to his request so easily!

Zhu Yan shouted crazily, “He cursed me, causing me to have demonic thoughts in my heart and my soul to shatter! I’ll use all my life and energy as the price to curse the master of the Demon Sect!”

His voice spread wildly, rippling through the entire universe, attracting the attention of countless people.

Then, Zhu Yan turned into a huge fireball and rushed up. In the end, he exploded in the air like a huge firework.

Dazzling, resplendent, and flowing lights shot in all directions.

Countless planets shook crazily.

Seeing this…

All the Fire God Palace disciples knelt on the ground dejectedly.

Then, someone shouted loudly.

“I’m irreconcilable with the Demon Sect!”

“We must kill the members of the Demon Sect!”

“Kill the Demon Sect!”

…

In fact, Zhu Yan’s voice not only aroused the hatred of the Fire God Palace disciples.

It had also caused the Water God Palace, the 10,000 Demons Sect, the Thunder Sect, and many other large factions to target the Demon Sect.

Firstly, the Water God Palace, the 10,000 Demons Sect, and the Thunder Sect had a grudge against the Demon Sect.

Secondly, since the Demon Sect could curse Zhu Yan to death, they could definitely curse them to death too.

This unknown and terrifying power must be killed!

Hence, the Demon Sect, which was already ostracized by many factions, directly became the target of everyone.

Branches were destroyed one after another, and planets would be occupied one by one…

For a moment, the Demon Sect seemed to have become a rat crossing the street, hated by everyone.

This change caught the Demon Sect off guard.

Many higher-ups were forced to hold an emergency meeting.

“Nearly a third of our Demon Sect’s base has been destroyed. We’ve suffered heavy losses!”

“Right now, it’s very difficult for our Demon Sect to recruit new disciples.”

“Recruit new disciples? Recently, a large number of old disciples are about to leave the sect.”

…

When the people from the Demon Sect said this, they all frowned.

This was definitely the greatest crisis the Demon Sect had faced in countless years.

“Sect Master, have you really mastered the powerful Curse?” someone suddenly asked.

When everyone heard this, they all looked at the tall sect master, whose facial features were hidden in the black fog.

“No.” The sect master sighed.

He was also very helpless.

Back then, it was Zhu Yan who had taken the initiative to look for him. He wanted to join forces with him to deal with the Water God Palace, the 10,000 Demons Sect, and the Thunder Sect.

The Demon Sect had a great hatred for these sects to begin with.

Therefore, he did not hesitate at all and agreed immediately.

In the beginning, the master of the Demon Sect was also on guard.

He was worried that Zhu Yan was pretending to cooperate.

However, as time passed, he realized that Zhu Yan really wanted to deal with the Water God Palace, the 10,000 Demons Sect, and the Thunder Sect.

In fact, his actions were quite similar to the Demon Sect.

Hence, the master of the Demon Sect gradually relaxed.

Who would have thought that Zhu Yan would actually do such a thing before he died?
